OR01.en: Board the train and enter a carriage with both your men without setting off the alarm.
OR01.zh: 登上列车，带领两名队员进入车厢，切勿触发警报。

TIP1.en: Only the Thief can climb. He can climb walls without the aid of special equipment. Left-Click on a wall to scale it. You are able to move sideways on some walls.
TIP1.zh: 只有小偷能攀爬。他无需特殊装备即可爬墙。左键点击墙壁即可攀爬。在某些墙壁上可以横向移动。
